content: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
story:
A shy lawyer who faced humiliating racial segregation on South African trains, Gandhi transformed his personal outrage into Satyagraha (soul-force or truth-force). Leading millions of impoverished Indians against the British Empire without firing a single shot, he demonstrated that uncompromising nonviolence and personal self-discipline possess a moral power capable of bringing empires to their knees.

This timeless reminder speaks to the universal struggle to balance inner truth with outer demands. Mahatma Gandhi understood that the measure of a meaningful life is not external approval, but the quiet integrity with which we meet each day's encounters.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
